inputUnits: Selection-time points per game, converted to points per drive by the shared drive count. Touchdown = 6 plus one extra-point attempt. Field goal = 3. Events are mutually exclusive. Late-clock touchdowns are funded from the same points-per-game budget.
seedPolicy: Primary seed is the first precommitted value (20241015). Seeds were listed before the run and were not reordered or dropped to obtain a PASS.
boundarySensitiveNote: Count of primary-seed games whose home ML sits within 0.01 of 0.45 or 0.55. Those games can enter or leave the official cohort when the draw noise moves.

priorE2aClaim.engine: nfl-drive before ppg-per-drive-v1: points per game were passed in as points per drive, then NCAAF inputs were multiplied by 0.48
priorE2aClaim.reason: The 2026-10-14 PASS used the same unit mismatch as the NFL draws that sat near 42 points per team. The 0.48 college scale was a patch on that mismatch, not a separate engine. This run is a new measurement. A numeric PASS does not restore that claim.

formMethodology: venue_split blended with L10 via blendVenueAndL10 (production footballGameSimInputs parity); no invented HFA constant
